professionalDescription_1: Contributed to the development of Go-Cal, a metrological management software optimized for the calibration and maintenance of equipment, ensuring compliance with ISO 17025. professionalDescription_2: Developed a tax simulator for merchants and entrepreneurs, automating tax calculations and generating PDF reports. Implemented the backend with Node.js, Express, TypeScript, Prisma ORM, and MongoDB, with JWT authentication and email notifications. Created a dynamic interface with React, Vite, and Ant Design, and developed an administrative panel to manage rates and economic indicators. professionalDescription_3: I work on the development of services and web and mobile applications for Lorry, a platform designed to optimize the management of bus and truck fleets. I focus on creating scalable backend architectures with Node.js and TypeScript, improving the performance and efficiency of queries in PostgreSQL, and strengthening security and robustness in report generation. Thanks to my contributions, system load times have decreased, critical processes operate with greater stability, and the applications now have solid standardization in their design patterns, facilitating scalability and maintenance.
professionalDescription_4: I develop Lorry, a fleet and tire management platform for freight and urban transport, with a Next.js web app and a Flutter mobile app. In this role I specialized in TPMS and IoT technology, integrating tire pressure and temperature sensors through MQTT, webhooks and third-party APIs, and built a real-time alerting microservice with push notifications to mobile devices. I deepened my AWS expertise by designing S3 storage with folder-based access control, IAM policies and signed URLs. I brought artificial intelligence and automation into business processes, extracting invoice data with Gemini and orchestrating integrations with n8n (Outlook emails, CSV files from OneDrive and automated email reports). On the backend I built APIs with Django REST Framework using a DDD architecture and domain events on MySQL, with asynchronous and scheduled tasks in CronTab. On the frontend I built interfaces with React, TypeScript, MUI and React Query, and contributed to lorry-ui, the internal component library.
